entities.name: Licid
entities.description: A species of parasitic or symbiotic magical organisms of Rath that bond with hosts and imbue them with abilities.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The artificial plane on which licids have appeared.

entities.name: Vec
entities.description: People of Rath who use beneficial licids for combat and ceremonies.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Ruler of Rath in whose operating theater licids were likely created or modified.

events.summary: Licids bond with a host, sinking their legs into it and melding at the point of contact, and later disengage without harm.
events.quote: Licids can bond with a host (usually a human ) and then imbue that creature with some ability .

relations.note: The Vec use licids for combat, ceremonies, cloth, implements and food.
relations.quote: The Vec use beneficial Licids to enhance their combat skills or as part of ceremonies.
Licids have only appeared on the artificial plane of Rath .
